<thought>Only carbon shows a clear M+1 isotopic peak (~8 % of the monoisotopic intensity) and a rapidly decreasing M+2, M+3 series, matching the typical 13C distribution for a molecule with several carbons. No other element exhibits its characteristic isotopic spacing or relative intensities in this spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
